avis.titre: why does a protective eye cream sting so badly?
avis.texte: I bought this myself. I thought DE would do a ceramide eye cream well. It was a decent heavy cream fow winter, but it stung my eyes so badly every application. Eye creams are supposed to be used around the eye area. It's not like I would put it IN my eyes, but you cant even get close to your lashes (or use a hudrating spray). For something designed for sensitive or mature skin and healing the skin barrier, I'm afraid this just doesn't instill confidence. You aren't supposed to burn your eyes, and I'm surprised they didn't catch that in formulation. They sure charge enough for it!

avis.titre: Best I've tried once I got over the sting
avis.texte: I love, love, love this cream. It is really moisturizing and it sits great under makeup. I used it throughout the winter and it makes such a difference. However, it did sting my eyes a lot at first and I was about to drop it when I saw a comment I need to wait it out, And indeed, my eyes appear to have "adjusted", and after a few (painful) days, I have zero problems.
Im not saying to go spend the money on it because its pricy but its really worth checking out it gives the perfect amount of hydration and it made my undereyes so smooth.
